title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN- SEPTEMBER 14th - Seyyed Abbas Mousavi, Deputy Chief of Protocol for the Office of the President elaborated on the visa issuance and whether president will travel to New York.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN- SEPTEMBER 14th - Seyyed Abbas Mousavi, Deputy Chief of Protocol for the Office of the President elaborated on the visa issuance and whether president will travel to New York."

""

"SOT, Abbas Mousavi, Deputy Chief of Protocol for the Office of the President (Farsi): "They had imposed some restrictions; for example, they said the accompanying delegation members should go to the interview location, except for the President and the Foreign Minister. Recently, our colleagues in New York held consultations, and the restrictions were lifted. Now, we don't know how many visas they will grant or when they will grant them. Well, if they don't, they will have acted contrary to the regulations and set a new precedent. Now we are weighing our options to see how the situation unfolds.
